Subject: Spike in usage — options for mid-contract capacity and pricing

Hi Naomi,

We saw a 3.8x spike in inference volume the last 30 days after pushing an AI feature to prod. Our current committed capacity is being exhausted rapidly and finance is asking for options that don't lock us into a full-year top-up right away.

Questions:
- Can we add temporary capacity that is billed pro-rata and then convert to a committed uplift later?
- Any early-renewal incentives or credits if we commit earlier than our renewal date (Dec 2027)?
- Will co-terming the uplift to our existing contract mean a full-year payment up-front?

Priya (cc) from our finance team will help with procurement constraints. Attaching the usage export for the last 30 days (large CSV) — happy to walk through.

Subject: Re: Spike in usage — options for mid-contract capacity and pricing

Thanks for the heads-up, Evan — and +1 to looping Priya. We can absolutely structure a path that avoids a full year payment immediately while giving you predictable throughput and a path to convert. High-level options below; I attached a one-page summary (Redwood_renewal_summary_v1.pdf).

Option A — Temporary surge buffer (fastest):
- Add a 60-day surge buffer (on-demand reserved bucket) sized to your 30-day peak.
- Billed monthly at on-demand rate; no long-term commit.
- If you convert this surge to committed capacity within the 60-day window, we apply a one-time conversion credit equal to 10% of the charges billed during the buffer period.

Option B — Staged uplift + co-term conversion (recommended for predictability):
- Immediate staged uplift (we add 40% committed capacity for the remainder of the quarter, prorated by days).
- At the next renewal (or earlier if you choose), you can annualize the uplift into a full commit.
- If you annualize within 90 days of uplift, we provide a 12% annual discount on the incremental commit (applies only to the uplifted amount).

Option C — Early renewal incentive (best unit economics):
- Commit now to a 12-month uplift and move your renewal to align (co-term).
- We can offer an early-commit discount up to 15% on incremental capacity and a 30-day invoice deferral for the annualized uplift.

Notes on invoicing: co-terming does not require a single up-front cash payment if you choose monthly invoicing for the new commit; we can structure monthly amortization with an executed amendment.

Next steps I suggest: 30-minute call with Ben (sales manager) and Logan (renewals ops) to pick the above and draft amendment. Available windows: Tue 5/3 10–11am PT or Wed 5/4 2–3pm PT.

If you prefer, I can draft the amendment and send a DocuSign link for internal approval after the call.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
